commands.name: 检查更新并升级
commands.command: sudo dpkg --configure -a && sudo apt update && sudo apt full-upgrade -y && sudo apt autoremove -y

commands.name: 安装图形处理软件Krita
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y krita krita-l10n

commands.name: 安装视频剪辑软件Kdenlive
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y kdenlive

commands.name: 安装科学计算软件Octave
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y octave

commands.name: 安装WPS
commands.command:
cat << 'EOF' | sh && sudo dpkg --configure -a && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/wps.deb
wget https://mirrors.sdu.edu.cn/spark-store/arm64-store/office/wps-office/wps-office_11.1.0.11720-fix3_arm64.deb -O /tmp/wps.deb
EOF
rm /tmp/wps.deb

commands.name: 安装CAJViewer
commands.command: wget https://download.cnki.net/cajPackage/tongxinUOS/signed_cajviewer_9.5.0-25268_arm64.deb -O /tmp/caj.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/caj.deb; rm /tmp/caj.deb

commands.name: 安装亿图图示
commands.command: wget https://cc-download.wondershare.cc/business/prd/edrawmax_13.1.0-1_arm64_binner.deb -O /tmp/edraw.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/edraw.deb && bash /home/tiny/.local/share/tiny/edraw/postinst; rm /tmp/edraw.deb

commands.name: 安装QQ
commands.command: wget $(curl -s https://cdn-go.cn/qq-web/im.qq.com_new/latest/rainbow/linuxConfig.js | grep -oP '"armDownloadUrl":{[^}]*"deb":"\K[^"]+') -O /tmp/qq.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/qq.deb && sed -i 's#Exec=/opt/QQ/qq %U#Exec=/opt/QQ/qq --no-sandbox %U#g' /usr/share/applications/qq.desktop; rm /tmp/qq.deb

commands.name: 安装微信
commands.command: wget https://dldir1v6.qq.com/weixin/Universal/Linux/WeChatLinux_arm64.deb -O /tmp/wechat.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/wechat.deb && echo '安装完成。如果你使用微信只是为了传输文件，那么可以考虑使用支持SAF的文件管理器（如：质感文件），直接访问小小电脑所有文件。'; rm /tmp/wechat.deb

commands.name: 安装钉钉
commands.command: wget $(curl -sw %{redirect_url} https://www.dingtalk.com/win/d/qd=linux_arm64) -O /tmp/dingtalk.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/dingtalk.deb libglut3.12 libglu1-mesa && sed -i 's#\./com.alibabainc.dingtalk#\./com.alibabainc.dingtalk --no-sandbox#g' /opt/apps/com.alibabainc.dingtalk/files/Elevator.sh; rm /tmp/dingtalk.deb

commands.name: 启用回收站
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y gvfs && echo '安装完成, 重启软件即可使用回收站。'

commands4En.name: Update Packages
commands4En.command: sudo dpkg --configure -a && sudo apt update && sudo apt full-upgrade -y && sudo apt autoremove -y

commands4En.name: Install Painting Program Krita
commands4En.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y krita krita-l10n

commands4En.name: Install KDE Non-Linear Video Editor
commands4En.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y kdenlive

commands4En.name: Install LibreOffice
commands4En.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y libreoffice

commands4En.name: Install WPS
commands4En.command:
cat << 'EOF' | sh && sudo dpkg --configure -a && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/wps.deb
wget https://github.com/tiny-computer/third-party-archives/releases/download/archives/wps-office_11.1.0.11720_arm64.deb -O /tmp/wps.deb
EOF
rm /tmp/wps.deb

commands4En.name: Install EdrawMax
commands4En.command: wget https://cc-download.wondershare.cc/business/prd/edrawmax_13.1.0-1_arm64_binner.deb -O /tmp/edraw.deb && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y /tmp/edraw.deb && bash /home/tiny/.local/share/tiny/edraw/postinst && sudo sed -i 's/<Language V="cn"\/>/<Language V="en"\/>/g' /opt/apps/edrawmax/config/settings.xml; rm /tmp/edraw.deb

commands4En.name: Enable Recycle Bin
commands4En.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y gvfs && echo 'Restart the app to use Recycle Bin.'
